Name: Silver's Llamas and Alpacas
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Farms just don't feel complete without llamas and/or alpacas right? So here's a mod that brings them to you!

This mod adds 3 varieties each of llamas and alpacas that live in your barns. Llamas produce llama wool, which can be spun into yarn using the Spinning Wheel found in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43832]Realistic Looms Redux[/url], which is required for this mod. Llama yarn can then be turned into llama cloth with a loom. Alpacas drop their own wool, which goes through the same process.

Enjoy!
